title: JTT — Private Beta Operations
description: BETA-P0-018. One screen for the private-beta operator: is it usable, is HTTPS healthy, how full is it, are sessions moving, is cleanup working, is isolation proven, are backups fresh, is the host under pressure. docs/runbooks/private-beta-operations.md.

panels.title: 1 · Is the platform usable right now?
Critical alerts firing
panels.description: Anything above zero: open the alert, then its runbook. docs/runbooks/private-beta-operations.md §2 says when to stop launches.

panels.title: Services scraped (api, terminal, sandboxd)
panels.description: 3 is healthy. Fewer: ServiceDown, RB-01.

panels.title: API ready
panels.description: /readyz on the API: catalogue loaded and database reachable.

panels.title: Container runtime (sandboxd)
panels.description: The runtime under the broker. The broker process itself is the "Services scraped" tile.

panels.title: 2 · HTTPS edge and certificate (BETA-P0-017 checks, run by the API)
Certificate days left
panels.description: notAfter of the certificate the edge serves. Yellow under 21 days (renew), red under 7 — the tls:check windows.

panels.title: HTTPS check (served)
panels.description: A browser-equivalent TLS request to the edge: chain, host name, expiry, protocol, HSTS.

panels.title: Minutes since the edge was checked
panels.description: The check runs every 5 minutes. Above 20: TlsEdgeCheckNotRunning.

panels.title: Current TLS findings
panels.description: Finding codes only. `npm run tls:check` on the host prints the full message.

panels.title: MAX_ACTIVE_SESSIONS
panels.description: The deployed ceiling. The private beta runs 5.

panels.title: Free slots
panels.description: Zero means the next Start Lab is refused (CapacityExhausted pages on the refusal).

panels.title: MAX_ACTIVE_SESSIONS_PER_STUDENT
panels.description: The beta runs 1.

panels.title: Refused: student at own limit (1h)
panels.description: Not a platform failure: a student already holding a lab pressed Start again.

panels.title: Sessions by status, against the ceiling
Oldest session in each status (minutes)
panels.description: Stuck lines: CREATING past 10, RESETTING past 15, ENDING/EXPIRING past 20, DEGRADED past 40 (RB-17).

panels.title: Reset Lab outcomes (per 30 minutes)
panels.description: failed = the session is DEGRADED. LabResetsFailing at 3 in 30 minutes.

panels.title: End Lab outcomes (per 30 minutes)
panels.description: pending = the delete is not yet confirmed; the reaper finishes it.

panels.title: Seconds since a successful sweep
panels.description: Above 300: ReaperStalled (critical).

panels.title: Errors in the last sweep
panels.description: Sweeps complete even when a teardown fails. Non-zero for 15 minutes: ReaperSweepErrorsPersisting.

panels.title: Unaccounted sandboxes
panels.description: Containers the runtime holds minus sessions the store knows. Negative: a teardown still in flight.

panels.title: NetworkPolicy enforcement attested
panels.description: BETA-P0-015. Not attested: Kubernetes labs are refused (RB-18).

panels.title: Attestation age (share of maximum)
panels.description: Re-run the enforcement probe before this reaches 100%. Warns at 75%.

panels.title: Capability scope denials (24h)
panels.description: Expected to be zero, always (ScopeDenialDetected).

panels.title: Authentication failures
panels.description: Rejected credentials exclude signed-out browsers. Sign-in failures are OIDC callbacks by outcome.

panels.title: Hours since the last successful backup
panels.description: Yellow past 26 hours (BackupStale), red past 50 (BackupMissedTwice).

panels.title: Hours since the last verification
panels.description: scripts/db-restore.sh --verify-only. Its cadence is DECISION REQUIRED; weekly is recommended.

panels.title: Last backup copied off the host
panels.description: The off-host destination is DECISION REQUIRED. NO means a lost host loses the backups too.

panels.title: Backup status readable
panels.description: The API can read the status directory the backup job writes. Not readable: freshness is unknown.

panels.title: 8 · Host pressure (read by the API from /proc and statfs)
Free space by filesystem
panels.description: container_root is where Docker keeps images, containers and volumes (PostgreSQL included). Warns under 15%, pages under 8%.
